proposition: Nafsat I is built as an introduction (autobiography and an attack on the accusers' character and motives) followed by two sections: nine hadith against innovation, then the sayings of Sufi masters and authorities in support of Sufism's orthodoxy.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to the ruler who was judging him
